title: Compute 50-kbar Fe-Ni phase boundaries
action: Set up the Fe-Ni system in pycalphad with an appropriate public thermodynamic database, incorporating molar volume data to account for the 50 kbar pressure effect. Compute the equilibrium phase boundaries (specifically the γ/(α+γ) transus) as a function of temperature and composition across the full Fe-Ni range. Save the raw phase boundary data for audit.
description: CSV containing the full γ/(α+γ) phase boundary locus at 50 kbars, used as intermediate evidence.
output_schema: CSV with columns: Ni_wtPct, T_C (temperature in Celsius along the boundary).

title: Extract boundary temperatures at specified Ni contents
action: From the computed 50-kbar phase boundaries, extract the γ/(α+γ) transformation temperature at Ni compositions of 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 55, and 60 wt% Ni. Write the results to table1_depressions.csv.
description: CSV containing the γ/(α+γ) phase boundary temperatures at 50 kbars for the eight specified Ni compositions.
output_schema: CSV with header row: Ni_wtPct, T_50kbar_C. Eight data rows, one per composition; both columns float.

title: Determine eutectoid presence at 50 kbars
action: Analyze the full 50-kbar phase diagram to verify whether a γ1+γ2 miscibility gap intersects the γ/(α+γ) phase boundary (i.e., whether a eutectoid is present). Write the conclusion to eutectoid_check.txt.
description: Text file stating the eutectoid presence verdict at 50 kbars.
output_schema: A single line of text, exactly one of: 'Eutectoid present at 50 kbars: YES' or 'Eutectoid present at 50 kbars: NO'.
